## Identity / provenance / hash groundwork (§9–§11, verified)

`mailroom_eda.identity` derives, as pure functions of each row:
`document_id` (`DOC-` + sha256(source_corpus + filename)[:16] — deterministic,
order/split/config-independent, never a row index), `source_corpus`,
`source_document_id`, `source_filename`, `source_revision` (cast-safe `""`
until a builder tracks per-row revisions), `content_sha256`,
`normalized_text_sha256`.

Verified over all 1,650 rows at the pinned revision (full results in the JSON
manifest): 100% unique `document_id`, 100% filename uniqueness, split rule
consistent, 100% hash coverage. Contract tests: `packages/mailroom-corpus-eda/tests/`
(§63/§64) — green against fixture + snapshot.

**Publishing state:** these fields are groundwork only. They ship on the
published configs with the **`v0.2-mailroom-hardened`** release (§84); no new
HF revision is pushed by P0.

## Findings

1. **Pin drift (fixed in this audit series).** The pipeline pin
   `FULL_CORPUS_REVISION` was `b3ec9ee7` (2026-08-31 purpose-GT push) — two
   revisions behind the corpus tip: it predated the v7 intent hydration
   (`1acd2600`) and the `intent_source` fix (`bb57c5ad`). The pin now tracks
   the tip; §44's "never evaluate unpinned" extends to "never evaluate a stale
   pin" — re-check the pin after every corpus-side push (the intent_backfill
   re-pin machinery exists for this).
2. **Exact duplicates exist and are kept (§12).** 2 exact-content duplicate
   groups (4 rows) at the baseline. Duplicates are Mailroom scenarios, not
   errors; per-row `duplicate_of` / `duplicate_type` classification lands with
   v0.2.
3. **`other` subclass spans types.** The catch-all subclass `other` appears
   under two classes — allowed by the contract (explicit fallback, never
   null); every other subclass maps to exactly one class.

## Known limitations

- `corporate_record` is small (39 rows); `attorney_demand` correspondence is
  scarce (3 rows, all v4-era) — honest gaps, not omissions.
- CMS DE-SynPUF claims are synthetic and homogeneous (PAID-only, `adjuster`
  null, health LOB) — deterministic-regression value, not realism (§39).
- No `matter_id` / `group_id` / relationships yet (P2, gated on the §14A
  methodology decision).
- No review/retry/arbiter ground truth yet (P1/P3).
- Correspondence extraction fields (sender, recipient, …) carry no corpus GT;
  the 27-key GT surface covers insurance extraction, contract/merger clause
  labels, and purpose GT — field-coverage gaps are P1 (§41).
